info.title: Microsoft Intune
info.description: Dual-purpose Microsoft Intune connector. Use the MCP endpoint to give an AI agent 105 Intune tools, or call the named actions directly from Power Automate and Logic Apps. Uses Microsoft Graph v1.0 whenever available and beta only for APIs that have not been promoted.
